subject: Re: CLAY kickoff — denoising our mobile UI datasets at scale
body:
Status + one risk before the final stretch.

Pipeline: synthetic-data generation is live — noise injection matches the empirical noise stats Katya measured on the audit set (node-visibility errors and type mislabels within 2% of observed rates). Denoiser trained on it hits 91.4 F1 on invisible-node detection against the hand-labeled audit set; the object typing model is at 87.9 macro-F1 across our 24 internal type classes.

Risk: tablet layouts. They're 9% of ingest volume but 31% of our residual errors — the noise distribution is genuinely different (multi-pane hierarchies). Options: (a) extend synthesis to tablet patterns, ~3 weeks, blows the May 11 window; (b) ship phone-layout cleaning now, gate tablet ingest behind a warning flag, extend in a fast-follow.

I recommend (b). Katya concurs — audit numbers on phone-only are launch-quality today.

Kaia
